title: Social reads and writes its room or shiur context in the reader's reserved ctx parameter

acs.text: WHEN social encodes a room or shiur context THE SYSTEM SHALL write `social.room.<id>` or `social.shiur.<id>`, valid in the reader's ctx grammar for any id matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,128}$`, and decode it back to the same context.
scenarios: Encode and decode a room context

acs.text: WHEN a ctx value is malformed, from another namespace, of an unknown kind, has an invalid id, or is not a string THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as no context.
scenarios: Foreign or malformed values are no context

acs.text: WHEN social adds or removes its context on a reader URL THE SYSTEM SHALL change only the `ctx` parameter, replace an earlier ctx when adding, keep a ctx from another namespace when removing, and keep the path, every other parameter and the hash byte for byte.
scenarios: Only ctx changes on a reader URL
